name: Can commercial construction be done on a tight deadline?

mainEntity.name: Can commercial construction be done on a tight deadline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but only if the scope is controlled and the team plans around permits, inspections, material lead times, and trade sequencing. Fast-track work usually requires earlier decisions, faster approvals, and close communication so delays do not stack up.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tight deadlines are possible, but only with clear scope, fast decisions, and strong coordination. Permits and material lead times still need to be managed.
